steps.text: Sign in to your Microsoft account in a web browser.

steps.note: The names can change. Look for Cancel or Turn off recurring billing.
Check the end date the service shows. Payments stop on the date you set.

steps.text: Check your email for a confirmation from Microsoft.
steps.note: If you bought through a store or a work account, cancel there. If you pay through Apple, Google or a mobile carrier, cancel there. See the Apple App Store or Google Play guide.
